promise: Close the Fessenheim nuclear plant in early 2020.
description: Macron announced in November 2018 that both Fessenheim units would close in early 2020. Unit 1 shut on 22 February 2020 and Unit 2 on 29 June 2020 - delivered despite union opposition and legal challenges.
evidence: Wikipedia Fessenheim: 'In November 2018, President Macron announced that both units would close in early 2020'
Unit 1 closed 22 February 2020; Unit 2 closed 29 June 2020

review.note: EDF confirms closure of units on 22 February and 29 June 2020. This establishes closure, not Macron's exact 27 November 2018 wording or conversion of early 2020 into a June 30 deadline. Those promise fields remain unresolved.
